title: Owl city music discs
description: This is a texture pack that turns the normal music discs into songs from the albums "Ocean Eyes" and "Maybe I'm Dreaming" by Owl City.
body: This is a texture pack that turns the normal music discs into songs from the albums Ocean Eyes and Maybe I'm Dreaming by Owl City. it changes the disc names and "now playing" title when you put it in a jukebox.
